body.notes: CATEGORY PAGE WORK 2026-09-08. Queued 1188-1194 (7 cards). 1188 = 301 for the nested full-size-track-loaders category URL. 1189-1194 = one verified CCOHS authority citation appended to each of the 6 category pages (45,39,43,47,41,37), all lint-clean, zero warnings. WHY citations: authority_links failed 6/6 in pre-publish-check and was the ONLY genuine content gap. Sources verified by direct fetch, not search snippet: trenching 1.2m protective-system rule (mini excavators), CCOHS landscaping-loaders rated-capacity/stability warning (wheel loaders, mini skid steers, track loaders), CCOHS MMH "most common cause of occupational fatigue and low back pain" (both dumper categories). IMPORTANT TRAP AVOIDED: a search snippet attributed a "three of four MMH workers suffer back injury / 40% of compensation costs" stat to CCOHS. Fetching the actual page shows NO such statistic. Always fetch before citing. CONTRAST DECISION: the site existing citation pattern uses green #01B51B inline, which is 2.75:1 on white and FAILS AA. All 6 target widgets verified sitting on #FFFFFF with #504532 body text (9.38:1). Used #017A12 (5.54:1) instead, same brand green darker. The guides (e.g. 3903) still carry the failing #01B51B and should be normalised. AUDIT COUNTS ARE MOSTLY FALSE POSITIVES, do not re-chase: paragraph_length 6/6 is the eael spec-comparison TABLE read as one giant paragraph on 5 of 6 pages (only 43 has genuine long prose); serp_snippet flags CTA headings phrased as questions ("Ready for Real Loader Power?"); em_dashes 4/6 = 8 lone spec-table cells + 1 inside a customer testimonial, ALL exempt under the standing ruling, nothing to fix. HONEST READ ON RANKINGS: these pages are already well optimised. Titles and meta descriptions are strong (prices, CAD, warranty, commercial intent), 1 H1 each, 477-764 words, spec tables, FAQs, and guide 3903 already links /mini-skidsteers/ FOUR times including anchor "mini skid steers for sale" plus 3 authority cites. The gap from position 11-12 to 8 is NOT on-page hygiene, it is domain authority and time plus the mini-skidsteers equity still recovering from the killed URL. Do not sell more on-page category work as a ranking fix. REAL REMAINING GAPS worth proposing: (1) author "Mammoth" (user id 2) has a 0-char bio, fails 6/6 site-wide E-E-A-T, and is a wp-admin user-profile task with no plugin route; (2) NO concrete buggy commercial page exists though "concrete buggy" sits at pos 8.0 with 243 impr and ZERO clicks served by the guide; (3) no skid steer attachments page though the home page ranks pos 1.2 for "skid steer attachments" with 95 impr and zero clicks.
